# jsQR vendor asset

- Package: `jsqr`
- Version: `1.4.0`
- Source: `https://registry.npmjs.org/jsqr/-/jsqr-1.4.0.tgz`
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`)

`jsQR.js` is the unmodified browser build from `package/dist/jsQR.js`. It is
served locally so iPhone/iPad browsers without the native `BarcodeDetector` API
can decode warehouse QR labels without uploading camera frames or depending on
a CDN at runtime.
